message.content: {"caption":"Three side-by-side line charts compare training, validation-selected, and unseen-test hard scores across epoch checkpoints for SpreadsheetBench, SearchQA, and LiveMath.","description":"The figure contains three line-chart panels. Each has Epoch checkpoint on the x-axis and Hard score on the y-axis; the panels use different y-axis ranges. The legend identifies Train rollout as a solid blue line with circular markers, Selection best as an orange dashed line with square markers, and Unseen test as a green dash-dot line with triangular markers. All plotted values are estimated from the axes; no point values are printed. (a) SpreadsheetBench, checkpoints 1, 2, 4, and 8: Train rollout stays high, around 0.88–0.92, with a small dip at 4 before rising at 8. Selection best rises sharply from about 0.37 at 1 to 0.80 at 2 and then remains level. Unseen test rises from about 0.50 to 0.71 at 2 and edges upward to about 0.75 by 8. At checkpoint 1, unseen test is above selection best; from checkpoint 2 onward, selection best is above unseen test, while train rollout is highest throughout. (b) SearchQA, checkpoints 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 16: Selection best rises from about 0.845 to 0.865 at checkpoint 2 and stays flat. Unseen test begins near 0.850, rises to about 0.863 at 4, then eases to about 0.858. Train rollout starts lowest, climbs to about 0.863 at 4, falls to about 0.842 at 12, then rebounds to about 0.865 at 16. The series nearly meet around checkpoint 4; at 16, train rollout reaches the selection-best level. (c) LiveMath, checkpoints 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, and 16: Selection best is nearly flat around 0.765 through checkpoint 12, then rises to about 0.825 at 16 and remains above the other series. Train rollout rises from about 0.515 to 0.630 at 2, drops to about 0.570 at 4 and 8, and then rises to about 0.655 by 16.
